title: Croatian Hash and Porridge Bowl
description: A hearty bowl filled with croatian hash, topped with a creamy porridge and a sprinkle of quick oats.
instructions: Heat the croatian hash in a pan over medium-high heat.
In a separate pot, bring the sour milk to a simmer.
Add the quick oats to the pot and cook, stirring constantly, until the oats have absorbed most of the liquid.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
To assemble the dish, place the cooked croatian hash in a bowl and top with the oat porridge.
